hypotheses.justification: The statement `σ g (Tr σ c) = Tr σ c` mentions only `σ`, `g`, `c`, the sum `∑ h, σ h c` (i.e. `Finset.univ.sum`), `A`, `G`, and the ring structure; `DecidableEq G` is nowhere in the statement — no `if h = 1` test, no `erase`, no `Finset` literal, and `Finset.sum` is defined via `Multiset.map`/`Multiset.sum` using decidable equality on `A` (from `CommRing`), not on `G` (`Finset.sum` takes only `[AddCommMonoid M]` since the underlying operation is a `Multiset` fold). The proof uses only `Tr`, `map_sum` (`map_sum (f : M →+ N) : f (∑ x ∈ s, g x) = ∑ x ∈ s, f (g x)`, an `AddMonoidHom` lemma, no decidability), `σ_mul_apply`/`map_mul` (`MonoidHom`/`RingEquiv`), `Fintype.sum_equiv`, which per `Finset.sum_bijective`/`Fintype.prod_bijective` uses only `Fintype` and bijectivity (`Eqv.mulLeft g` is a bijection by `mul_right_cancel`-style left cancellation, available from `Group`), and `rfl`. There is no `decide`/`split_ifs` in the proof, so `[DecidableEq G]` is never needed. Deleting it (e.g. via `omit [DecidableEq G] in` or removing it from the `section Main` variables) leaves a true, provable statement: the proof works verbatim, with `simp only [Tr, map_sum, ← σ_mul_apply]` and `Fintype.sum_equiv (Equiv.mulLeft g) _ _ (fun _ => rfl)` unchanged, since none of these require decidable equality on `G`. Note that `[Fintype G]` cannot be deleted: the statement's sum `∑ h, σ h c` elaborates to `∑ h ∈ Finset.univ, ...`, which needs `Fintype G` to resolve `Finset.univ`. `[Group G]`, `[CommRing A]` and the `variable` `A₀`/`[CommRing A₀]`/`[Algebra A₀ A]` are also needed for elaboration (`σ`, `A`, and the `Algebra` instance being the default ambient one that `Algebra` notation/TC resolution in the section relies on), so `[DecidableEq G]` is the single deletable hypothesis.
